description: Configuration panel assets before the signalk-nearlcrews-ui migration
approval: Recalibrated for the signalk-nearlcrews-ui 0.8.2 upgrade, which measures 34371 gzip bytes. The 0.8.2 additions are the single-frame action-bar settling and its docking hysteresis, the skipped clearance scroll when a pointer moves focus, the compact and icon-only button size floor, and the theme re-sync on section reveal, together worth 131 bytes over 0.8.1's measured 34240, net of the merge-list reorder override this release drops because the library now owns that floor. The ceiling stays at 36000, where 0.8.1 set it: 34240 left only 2 percent of headroom, where the rest of the plugin family runs 5 to 10 percent, so an ordinary panel edit would have failed the gate rather than a real regression. The 0.8.1 additions were the deferred-clearance pointer handling and the bounded docking measurement that fix the viewport-bottom action bar, plus the segmented-control form-reset fix, worth 260 bytes over 0.8.0's measured 33980. The 0.8.0 growth was runtime popover-trigger and labelable-control validation, the panel-contained toast viewport host, and viewport-bottom action-bar focus preservation; the prior 33000-byte ceiling covered the 0.7.0 migration.
